fields.original: 15秒电影感日料广告。深色木质料理台，左上方暖光，浅景深，舒缓纯音乐。0–3秒俯拍整条带冰三文鱼，白衣厨师扶住鱼头尾；3–7秒切极近微距，厨刀切入橙红鱼柳；7–12秒切近景，厨师给饭团覆鱼片、按压，用银镊点上绿叶；12–15秒切成品展示。 最后一镜中，成品在哑光黑盘正中，日文书法「一期一会、極上の味」从左到右写出，墨色渐浓，末笔落定微光定格。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, in an overhead high-angle shot, the camera pushes in at slow speed toward a whole, fresh salmon resting atop a bed of crushed glistening ice on a dark oiled wood counter. A middle-aged male chef wearing a crisp white cotton sushi uniform stands behind the counter, his bare hands carefully holding and stabilizing the fish by its silver-scaled head on the left and tapered tail on the right. Warm directional key light spills from the upper-left corner, highlighting melting water droplets and iridescent scales against the rich shadowed wood, creating a shallow depth of field. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to an extreme macro shot as the camera pans right at slow speed, tracking the blade of a polished single-bevel yanagiba knife slicing cleanly through a thick, vibrant orange-red salmon fillet on a dark wooden cutting board. The razor-sharp edge glides through the flesh at a low diagonal angle, parting the distinct white intramuscular fat striations with smooth precision, revealing glistening moisture across the cut surface under the warm upper-left rim light. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up from an eye-level angle holding a static shot of the chef's hands crafting a piece of nigiri. His deft fingers gently drape the sliced salmon fillet over an oval mound of vinegared sushi rice, executing a precise two-stroke press to mold the sushi firmly. He then lifts a pair of slender silver culinary tweezers and delicately sets a single fresh microgreen leaf onto the center of the fish, his hands moving with practiced rhythm against the out-of-focus dark wooden interior. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a close-up slightly high-angle shot as the camera pushes in at slow speed toward the finished salmon nigiri positioned squarely in the center of a circular matte black ceramic plate. Traditional Japanese calligraphy appears on screen, writing from left to right across the upper half of the frame in flowing sumi ink strokes to form "一期一会、極上の味", the ink density deepening from a soft wash to dense charcoal black, culminating in a subtle glint across the final brushstroke before settling into a pristine freeze-frame.
overall_soundscape: The delicate crunch and rustle of crushed ice shifting under the fish is clearly heard in the room tone, followed by the crisp, pronounced hiss and glide of the chef's knife parting the tender salmon fillet. Soft, audible finger presses against the moist rice grains accompany the assembly, punctuated by a distinct metallic click of tweezers setting the garnish. A muted, resonant ceramic tap concludes the sequence as the plate settles on the counter, accompanied by a quiet, warm interior kitchen ambience.
non_diegetic_music: A slow-tempo acoustic score featuring gentle solo piano chords intertwined with sustained, resonant koto plucks and a quiet, low-register cello pad underneath. The arrangement maintains a consistent, understated dynamic without crescendo, tapering to a sustained single note at the final rest.
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影，在头顶高角度镜头中，摄影机以缓慢的速度向一整条新鲜的鲑鱼推进，这条鲑鱼躺在深色涂油木柜台上的碎冰床上。一位穿着整洁的白棉厨师服的中年男厨师站在柜台后面，空手小心翼翼地握住并稳定着左边银色鳞片的鱼头和右边锥形的鱼尾。温暖的定向主光从左上角溢出，突出了融化的水滴和虹彩鳞片与丰富的阴影木材的对比，创造了浅景深。 [镜头 2] 00:03.000，镜头以低速平移，切换到极端微距镜头，追踪抛光单刃柳刃包丁的刀刃，干净利落地切开深色木质切板上厚厚的、充满活力的橙红色鲑鱼片。锋利的边缘以低对角线滑过肉，以光滑的精度分开明显的白色肌肉内脂肪条纹，在温暖的左上边缘光下，在切割表面上显示出闪闪发光的水分。 [镜头 3] 00:07.000，镜头从与眼睛齐平的角度切换到中特写，拍摄了厨师双手制作手握寿司的静态镜头。他灵巧的手指轻轻地将切片三文鱼片放在椭圆形的醋寿司饭上，执行精确的两冲程按压，使寿司牢固成型。然后，他举起一把细长的银色烹饪镊子，小心地将一片新鲜的微绿叶子放在鱼的中心，双手以熟练的节奏在失焦的深色木质内部移动。 [镜头 4] 00:12.000，镜头切换到一个略高角度的特写镜头，镜头以慢速推向位于圆形哑光黑色陶瓷盘中央的成品三文鱼握寿司。传统的日本书法出现在屏幕上，从左到右，用流动的墨笔在画面的上半部分书写，形成"一期一会、極上の味"，墨水浓度从柔和的水洗加深到浓密的炭黑，最终在最后的笔触上出现微妙的闪烁，然后进入原始的定格画面。
整体声景：房间里清晰地听到碎冰在鱼下面移动时发出的微妙的嘎吱声和沙沙声，随后是厨师刀切开嫩鲑鱼片时发出的清脆、明显的嘶嘶声和滑动声。装配过程中，手指轻按潮湿的米粒，发出声音，中间夹杂着镊子设置装饰时发出的明显金属咔哒声。当盘子放在柜台上时，静音、回响的陶瓷轻叩声结束了整个序列，伴随着安静、温暖的室内厨房氛围。
非叙事音乐：慢速原声乐谱以柔和的钢琴独奏和弦与持续、共鸣的日本筝的拨弦声和安静的低音大提琴垫交织在一起。该编曲保持了一致、低调的动态，没有渐强，在最后的休息处逐渐减弱为持续的单音符。

fields.original: 傍晚街边，女孩起身撑开粉色雨伞。车灯扫过她的脸，她看一眼手机，沿街走了几步又回头。撑伞的时候，她自己说了一句：英语“Time to go home...” 。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, a medium shot at eye level as the camera slowly pushes in on a curbside sidewalk at dusk. A young East Asian woman in her early twenties with a soft, quiet voice (S1), featuring delicate facial features and shoulder-length black hair pulled into a low, loose ponytail with damp wisps curling at her temples, is initially seated on a damp wooden bench on the right side of the frame. She wears an unbuttoned beige wool trench coat over a charcoal grey knit turtleneck sweater, dark tailored trousers, and black waterproof leather ankle boots. Behind her stands a brick storefront facade beside a rain-slicked curb, bathed in the soft amber glow of an overhead streetlamp amidst a steady drizzle. She rises gracefully to her feet, lifting a closed pink nylon umbrella with a curved wooden handle. As she pushes the runner upward until the canopy snaps tautly open, the intense white beam of a passing car's headlights sweeps across her face from the left, briefly casting bright highlights and shifting shadows across her cheeks. Holding the umbrella aloft, the young woman (S1) lowers her gaze and murmurs softly to herself, <d>[English] Time to go home...</d>. She then reaches into her right coat pocket, retrieves a slim black smartphone, and raises it to eye level, her face momentarily bathed in the pale bluish glow of the lock screen as she checks the time. [Shot 2] At 00:06.800, the camera cuts to a medium-wide tracking shot at waist level, tracking forward and slightly rightward parallel to the wet pavement. The young woman in the beige trench coat from Shot 1 (S1) slides the phone back into her pocket and begins walking along the curb, holding the pink umbrella from Shot 1 angled slightly backward over her shoulder. Rain puddles on the asphalt mirror the blurry red taillights of distant traffic and golden shop window displays in the background. After taking four slow, measured strides, her steps decelerate and she comes to a complete halt on the sidewalk. She shifts her weight, lowers the umbrella slightly, and turns her head over her left shoulder to gaze thoughtfully back down the empty, mist-shrouded street behind her, her quiet silhouette framed against the soft evening city bokeh.
overall_soundscape: A continuous, distinct patter of light rain falling onto wet asphalt and taut nylon umbrella fabric creates a persistent ambient backdrop, alongside the low, muffled hum of distant city traffic. The sharp, mechanical click of an umbrella mechanism locking open is clearly heard, immediately followed by the loud whoosh of car tires rolling over wet pavement as headlights sweep past. Gentle rustling of wool fabric accompanies the character's movement, followed by audible, rhythmic footfalls splashing lightly into shallow puddles before stopping abruptly in the quiet evening air.
non_diegetic_music: A slow-tempo solo acoustic piano plays a sparse, contemplative melody over sustained, low cello notes in the background, maintaining a steady, minimal dynamic throughout without sudden swells.
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般的，在视线水平的中景镜头，摄影机在黄昏时慢慢推入路边人行道。一位二十岁出头的年轻东亚女性，声音轻柔、安静（S1），五官精致，齐肩的黑发扎成低松的马尾辫，鬓角卷曲着潮湿的缕缕，最初坐在画面右侧的潮湿木凳上。她穿着一件未扣扣的米色羊毛风衣，外面套着炭灰色针织高领毛衣、深色剪裁长裤和黑色防水皮革踝靴。她身后是一栋砖砌的店面，旁边是被雨水打湿的路边，在细雨中沐浴在头顶路灯柔和的琥珀色光芒中。她优雅地站起来，举起一把带有弯曲木柄的闭合粉色尼龙伞。当她向上推动跑步者直到顶篷拉紧打开时，一辆驶过的汽车前灯的强烈白色光束从左侧扫过她的脸，短暂地在她的脸颊上投射出明亮的高光和移动的阴影。高举伞的年轻女子（S1）低下目光，轻声自言自语，<d>[English] Time to go home...</d>。然后，她把手伸进右外套口袋，取出一部细长的黑色智能手机，并将其举至与视线齐平的位置，在检查时间时，她的脸瞬间沐浴在锁屏的淡蓝色光芒中。 [镜头 2] 00:06.800，摄像机切换到腰部高度的中广角跟踪镜头，向前并稍微向右倾斜，平行于潮湿的路面。镜头 1 (S1) 中穿着米色风衣的年轻女子将手机滑回口袋，开始沿着路边行走，手里拿着镜头 1 中的粉红色雨伞，雨伞稍微向后倾斜在肩上。沥青上的雨坑映照出远处交通模糊的红色尾灯和背景中金色的商店橱窗展示。缓慢而有节奏地迈出四步后，她的脚步减慢，在人行道上完全停了下来。她转移身体重心，稍微放下伞，将头转过左肩，若有所思地凝视着身后空荡荡、薄雾笼罩的街道，她安静的轮廓映衬在柔和的城市夜色背景虚化下。
整体声景：连续、清晰的小雨落在潮湿的沥青和绷紧的尼龙伞织物上，创造了一个持久的环境背景，旁边是远处城市交通的低沉、低沉的嗡嗡声。可以清楚地听到伞机构锁定打开时发出的尖锐的机械咔哒声，紧接着是车头灯扫过时汽车轮胎在潮湿的路面上滚动的巨大呼啸声。角色的动作伴随着羊毛织物的轻柔沙沙声，随后是可听见的、有节奏的脚步声，轻轻溅入浅水坑，然后在安静的夜晚空气中突然停止。
非叙事音乐：慢节奏的原声钢琴独奏在背景中持续的、低沉的大提琴音符上演奏出稀疏的、沉思的旋律，自始至终保持稳定、最小的动态，没有突然的膨胀。

fields.original: 水墨山林中，青石上的刀客缓慢抽出山纹弯刀，低声说“此山，不容匪行。”山匪首领从树影中走出，回答“山林自有强者居之。”下一瞬二人身影交错，两刀相碰，枝叶被震落。全程静音。
fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, medium shot with a slow push in framing an adult male on-screen swordsman with sharp, weathered features (S1), perched atop a massive, moss-flecked greenish-blue boulder. He wears layered charcoal-grey linen robes cinched with a dark leather belt, his shoulder-length black hair partly secured in a topknot while loose strands drift across his focused face. The surrounding scenery resembles a classical Chinese ink-wash painting, dominated by twisted ink-black pine branches, jagged stone precipices, and dense swirls of pale mountain mist under cold, diffused overhead daylight. Reaching down to his side, the swordsman (S1) slowly and deliberately draws a gleaming curved sabre etched with delicate mountain-grain patterns from its lacquered scabbard, tightening his gaze as he lowers his chin and says in a low, resonant murmur, <d>[Chinese] 此山，不容匪行。</d> A sudden mountain updraft billows the hem of his robe, while his eyes remain unblinking and fixed on the shadowy path ahead. [Shot 2] At 00:05.100, the camera cuts to a medium-wide shot with a slow pan left into the gloom between dense pine trunks, where an adult male on-screen bandit chief with a broad frame and a stubbled, scar-creased jaw (S2) steps forth from the foliage. He is clad in coarse, patched hemp garments reinforced with worn animal pelt across his shoulders and iron-studded bracers, gripping the cord-wrapped hilt of a broad steel machete resting on his shoulder. Halting his heavy stride upon the damp, leaf-littered soil, the bandit chief (S2) sneers defiantly, tilting his chin up as he replies in a coarse, booming voice, <d>[Chinese] 山林自有强者居之。</d> He rolls his shoulders forward and slides his broad blade down into a two-handed combat grip, his weight shifting forward aggressively. [Shot 3] At 00:09.600, the shot transitions to a wide tracking shot capturing the open clearing between them. In an instantaneous surge of agility, the swordsman from Shot 1 and the bandit chief from Shot 2 charge forward, their silhouettes darting across the misty mountain clearing and crossing paths mid-stride. Their blades meet in a fierce, kinetic strike at the center of the frame, the mountain-patterned sabre grinding against the heavy machete; the violent physical impact shudders upward into the surrounding canopy, dislodging a thick shower of pine needles and bamboo leaves that rain down through the fog. The two weapons rebound instantly, and both men slide across the wet stone and damp earth to land in grounded defensive stances with their backs turned to each other, perfectly still amid the falling leaves as dense currents of air sweep across the ravine.
overall_soundscape: A distinct metallic rasp is clearly heard as the curved sabre glides smoothly from its scabbard, followed by the audible, crunching thud of heavy leather boots stepping upon wet soil and pine needles. As the two warriors launch forward, the distinct, rapid whoosh of layered fabric slicing through the air is audible. At the instant the two blades meet and rebound, all weapon impact sounds give way to a dominant, loud rush of wind whipping through the high canopy, accompanied by the pronounced rustle and patter of dislodged leaves cascading downward, which transitions into the continuous, echoing howl of cold mountain wind reverberating throughout the desolate valley.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般的中景镜头，缓慢推进，画面中一位成年男性银幕剑客，面容锐利，饱经风霜（S1），栖息在一块巨大的、长满青苔的蓝绿色巨石上。他穿着分层的炭灰色亚麻长袍，用深色皮带系紧，齐肩的黑发部分扎成顶髻，松散的发丝飘过他专注的脸庞。周围的景色就像一幅中国古典水墨画，主要是扭曲的墨黑色松枝、锯齿状的石崖，以及在寒冷、漫射的头顶日光下浓浓的苍白山雾。剑客（S1）侧身侧身，缓慢而刻意地从漆鞘中拔出一把闪闪发光的弯刀，上面刻有精致的山纹图案，他目光紧绷，低着下巴，低声说道：<d>[Chinese] 此山，不容匪行。</d>突然山风卷起他的衣摆，他的眼睛却一眨不眨地盯着他。前方的阴暗道路。 [镜头 2] 00:05.100，镜头切换到中广角镜头，缓慢平移到茂密的松树树干之间的阴暗处，画面中一位成年男性强盗首领从树叶中走出来，他有着宽阔的身躯和留着胡茬、有疤痕的下巴（S2）。他穿着粗糙的、打补丁的麻布衣服，肩上用破旧的动物毛皮加固，戴着铁钉护腕，握着肩上宽大的钢砍刀的绳索柄。强盗首领（S2）在潮湿、落叶的土地上停下沉重的步伐，挑衅地冷笑，抬起下巴，用粗哑、洪亮的声音回答：<d>[Chinese] 山林自有强者居之。</d>他向前滚动肩膀，将宽大的刀刃向下滑入双手战斗握持中，他的体重积极地向前移动。 [镜头 3] 在 00:09.600，镜头转换为广角跟踪镜头，捕捉他们之间的开阔空地。第一镜头的剑客和第二镜头的土匪首领身形瞬间敏捷，向前冲锋，两人的身影在迷雾缭绕的山间空地中疾驰，跨过小路。他们的刀刃在框架中央以猛烈的动能攻击相遇，山形图案的军刀与重型砍刀摩擦；剧烈的物理冲击向上颤抖到周围的树冠，使厚厚的松针和竹叶从雾气中落下。两件武器立即反弹，两人滑过潮湿的石头和潮湿的泥土，以防御姿势落地，背对着对方，在落叶中一动不动，浓密的气流席卷山谷。
整体声景：当弯曲的军刀从刀鞘中平稳滑出时，可以清楚地听到明显的金属摩擦声，随后是沉重的皮靴踩在潮湿的土壤和松针上发出的嘎吱嘎吱的声音。当两名战士向前推进时，可以听到分层织物划破空气的独特而快速的呼啸声。在两把刀刃相遇并反弹的那一刻，所有武器撞击的声音都被一阵风吹过高高的树冠所发出的主导声音所取代，伴随着掉落的树叶倾泻而下的沙沙声和拍打声，最后转变为寒冷山风的持续呼啸声，回荡在整个荒凉的山谷中。
非叙事音乐：不适用

fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, wide shot at eye level as the camera executes a slow push in across an expansive, deep black void. Streams of finely textured, luminous golden sand sweep dynamically into frame from the far left, glittering with bright specular highlights against the surrounding darkness. The particles coil across the midground in fluid, ribbon-like trajectories before converging directly in the center of the frame. As the grains collide and compact, they coalesce into the traditional calligraphic brushstrokes of two characters reading "历史". An adult male off-screen narrator with a solemn, resonant tone (S1) intones, <d>[Chinese] 历史的长河在此刻奔涌而出。</d> with his lips remaining completely closed throughout, while the solidifying golden strokes gleam with a warm amber luster. Tiny glowing embers and loose grains flake away from the character edges, drifting languidly into the pitch-black periphery as the formed title stabilizes.
overall_soundscape: A deep, subtle ambient void hum underlies the space, accompanied by the distinct rushing hiss and rustle of countless sand particles sweeping across the darkness. Audibly pronounced micro-clatters and delicate crystalline clinks occur as the grains collide and lock into typography, followed by a faint airy whoosh as residual dust drifts away.
non_diegetic_music: A deep, resonant Chinese big drum (dagu) strikes in measured, slow-tempo single beats, alternating with a solo brass horn sustaining a bright, focused long note that swells in a steady crescendo before abruptly cutting off, leaving a long, cavernous reverberation across the acoustic space.
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般的广角镜头，镜头在视线水平位置缓慢推进，穿过广阔、深邃的黑色虚空。纹理细腻、发光的金色沙流从最左边动态地扫入画面，在周围的黑暗中闪烁着明亮的镜面高光。粒子以流体、带状轨迹盘旋穿过中景，然后直接汇聚到画面中心。当颗粒碰撞并压实时，它们会合并成两个字符的传统书法笔画："历史"。一位成年男性的画外旁白，以庄严、洪亮的语调（S1）吟诵着《<d>[Chinese] 历史的长河在此刻奔涌而出。</d>》，他的嘴唇自始至终都完全闭合，凝固的金色笔触闪烁着温暖的琥珀色光泽。当形成的标题稳定下来时，微小的发光余烬和松散的颗粒从字符边缘剥落，慵懒地漂入漆黑的边缘。
整体声景：空间中弥漫着深沉、微妙的周围虚空嗡嗡声，伴随着无数沙粒扫过黑暗的明显的嘶嘶声和沙沙声。当颗粒碰撞并锁定在版式中时，会发出明显的微响声和精致的水晶叮当声，随后随着残留的灰尘飘走而发出微弱的空气呼啸声。
非叙事音乐：深沉、洪亮的中国大鼓（大鼓）以有节奏的、慢速的单拍敲击，与独奏的铜管喇叭交替，维持明亮、集中的长音，在突然中断之前以稳定的渐强音增强，在声学空间中留下长长的、空洞的混响。

fields.pe:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, a wide shot opens from a slightly low angle, framing a solitary, jagged granite mountain peak piercing through an expansive sea of dense, churning white and slate-grey clouds beneath a pale twilight sky. In the center of the frame atop the precipice stands a graceful female warrior in her early twenties (S1) with sharp, poised facial features and obsidian-black hair bound high in a sleek topknot secured with a silver hairpin and fluttering black ribbons. She is dressed in layered martial robes crafted from heavy crimson and ink-black silk, featuring expansive sleeves intricately embroidered with golden phoenix feather patterns. As the shot unfolds, she rises weightlessly from the crag, floating upward into the open air as her voluminous sleeves spread wide like the wings of an ascending phoenix, billowing dramatically against the updrafts. Simultaneously, the camera performs a fluid Push In combined with a slow Roll Clockwise, spiraling closer through the atmosphere toward her. As the framing tightens into an intense face close-up, her steady, unflinching dark eyes lock forward with quiet resolve. In precise synchronization with her mouth movements, the young female on-screen warrior with a calm, low-pitched voice (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 他们说，我该隐于黑暗？</d> Following the spoken question, her lips close firmly, her jaw tightens with subtle defiance, and her gaze remains fixed ahead as loose wisps of hair drift gently across her temple while she hovers suspended above the abyss.
overall_soundscape: A faint, distant mountain draft whistles softly in the background, starkly overridden by the pronounced close-up acoustic environment of an indoor coffee shop. The distinct metallic clinking of a teaspoon tapping repeatedly against the rim of a ceramic cup rings out clearly in the foreground, followed immediately by the loud, sharp hiss and sputter of a pressurized espresso machine steaming milk. In the quiet pauses surrounding the spoken voice, the muted, overlapping chatter and low murmur of indoor cafe patrons are clearly heard, punctuated by a distant clatter of porcelain saucers settling onto a wooden counter.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般，广角镜头从略低的角度开始，拍摄出一座孤零零、锯齿状的花岗岩山峰，山峰穿透苍白暮色天空下的一片广阔的、浓密的、翻腾的白色和石板灰色云海。悬崖顶上的画面中央矗立着一位二十岁出头的优雅女战士（S1），她有着棱角分明、泰然自若的五官，黑曜石般的黑色头发高高地扎成光滑的头髻，并用银色发夹和飘动的黑色缎带固定。她穿着由深红色和墨黑色丝绸制成的分层武袍，宽大的袖子上绣有精美的金色凤凰羽毛图案。随着镜头的展开，她从悬崖上失重地升起，向上漂浮到露天，她宽大的袖子像腾飞的凤凰翅膀一样张开，在上升气流中戏剧性地翻滚。与此同时，摄像机执行流畅的推入和缓慢的顺时针滚动，穿过大气层向她靠近。当画面收紧为一张激烈的脸部特写时，她那双坚定、毫不畏缩的黑眼睛以平静的决心锁定前方。与她的嘴部动作精确同步，年轻的银幕女战士用平静、低沉的声音（S1）说道，<d>[Chinese] 他们说，我该隐于黑暗？</d>随着口头问题，她的嘴唇紧闭，她的下巴带着微妙的挑衅而收紧，她悬浮在深渊之上，她的目光始终盯着前方，松散的发丝轻轻地飘过她的太阳穴。
整体声景：远处微弱的山风在背景中轻轻呼啸，完全被室内咖啡厅明显的特写声学环境所掩盖。茶匙反复敲击陶瓷杯边缘时发出的明显金属叮当声在前景中清晰地响起，紧接着是加压浓缩咖啡机热气腾腾的牛奶发出的响亮而尖锐的嘶嘶声和溅射声。在说话声周围的安静停顿中，可以清楚地听到室内咖啡馆顾客的低声、重叠的喋喋不休和低声窃窃私语，不时被远处瓷碟落在木柜台上的碰撞声打断。
非叙事音乐：不适用

fields.original: 固定近景，桌边一只杯子滑落。镜头拍清透明薄玻璃杯落在石地上碎成数块，碎片散开，房间很安静。碰地的一刻响起空塑料杯弹地般的“扑、哒”，散开的碎片落地仍是短促的塑料轻响，时点全部落在对应动作上。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, in a static close-up shot angled downward toward the juncture between the beveled edge of a dark walnut dining table in the upper frame and a smooth, cool-toned gray slate stone tile floor stretching across the lower two-thirds of the frame. Soft, diffuse morning light enters from a large off-screen window on the left, casting a faint linear sheen across the polished wood varnish and throwing gentle specular highlights onto the curved lip of a thin, completely transparent cylindrical glass tumbler sitting right on the table's perimeter. The tumbler begins to creep outward over the edge, its flat base losing purchase on the glossy surface before tipping forward into empty air. The glass cup tumbles downward in free fall, twisting through the shadowed space beneath the tabletop overhang. Upon striking the hard slate floor, the delicate body instantaneously fractures into numerous sharp, jagged transparent shards and slivers that burst outward in an irregular radial spread. The largest base section skids several inches across the stone texture, while smaller triangular fragments bounce and tumble with minute secondary hops, sliding across the grout seams before friction arrests their movement, leaving the scattered glass glittering in stillness across the floor as airborne dust motes drift slowly through the quiet room.
overall_soundscape: A deep, quiet ambient room tone establishes a faint hum in the background, interrupted abruptly as the falling cup impacts the stone ground with a distinct, hollow, plastic-like thud and double-clack, followed immediately by a rapid sequence of short, crisp plastic taps and clicks as the scattering shards bounce and skitter across the slate floor before settling into absolute silence.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
fields.zh:
整合视听描述：[镜头 1] 电影般的静态特写镜头，向下倾斜，朝向上部画面中深色胡桃木餐桌的斜边与横跨画面下部三分之二的光滑、冷色调的灰色板岩瓷砖地板之间的交界处。柔和的漫射晨光从左侧的大窗外射入，在抛光的木漆上投射出淡淡的线性光泽，并在桌子周边的一个薄的、完全透明的圆柱形玻璃杯的弯曲边缘上投射出柔和的镜面高光。不倒翁开始从边缘向外蠕动，其平坦的底座失去了对光滑表面的支撑力，然后向前倾斜到空旷的空气中。玻璃杯以自由落体的方式向下翻滚，扭曲穿过桌面悬垂下方的阴影空间。当撞击到坚硬的石板地板时，脆弱的身体瞬间碎裂成无数锋利、锯齿状的透明碎片和条子，并以不规则的径向扩散向外爆裂。最大的底部部分在石头纹理上滑动了几英寸，而较小的三角形碎片则以微小的二次跳跃弹起和翻滚，在摩擦力阻止其运动之前滑过灌浆接缝，当空气中的尘埃微粒缓慢地飘过安静的房间时，散落的玻璃在地板上静止地闪闪发光。
整体声景：深沉、安静的室内环境音调在背景中营造出微弱的嗡嗡声，当掉落的杯子撞击到石头地面时，没有发出任何声音，分散的碎片在石板地板上弹跳和滑过，然后陷入绝对的寂静。
非叙事音乐：不适用
